--- text
a|😀b
--- keys
Right
--- expect
a😀|b
--- note
One ArrowRight moves by grapheme cluster, not by UTF-16 code unit. The
grinning-face emoji U+1F600 is a single astral code point stored as a
surrogate pair (two code units), so it is one cluster. CodeMirror's default
cursorCharRight runs @marijn/find-cluster-break, which advances over the whole
code point (codePointSize 2) and then stops before 'b'. The caret must land at
offset 3, never between the two surrogate halves at offset 2.
